{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Count total loyal customers and converted loyal customers
n_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
n_converted_loyal = len(loyal_customers[loyal_customers['converted'] == 1])

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted = n_converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print all required numbers
print("Total loyal customers:", n_loyal)
print("Converted loyal customers:", n_converted_loyal)
print("Fraction converted:", fraction_converted)"}
